faq.heading: Questions, answered
faq.q1: When and where is CUSEC 2027 happening?
faq.a1:
CUSEC 2027 will be held in Montréal from January 8th to 10th, 2027 at:

Hotel Omni Mont-Royal

1050 Sherbrooke St W, Montreal, Quebec H3A 2R6
faq.q2: Where can I find the conference schedule, speakers, and sponsors?
faq.a2: The schedule will be available on the website soon, along with our list of speakers! We are working to create the best conference experience for you, we promise.
faq.q3: Who can attend? Are there any costs?
faq.a3:
High school, undergraduate, and graduate students from all across Canada are welcome to attend.

  • Student Ticket: $118 CAD — for students still registered as of January 2027.
  • Professional Ticket: $270 CAD — for professionals, or students who have graduated by January 2027.

Tickets do not include travel or accommodation costs. Check the Pricing section for more details on ticket benefits.
faq.q4: How can I get a ticket?
faq.a4:
Pre-sale opens first for schools with a Head Delegate — speak with your Head Delegate about pre-purchased tickets for your school.

General Admission opens afterwards and stays open until tickets sell out. Exact dates are announced closer to the event. (Buy Tickets)
faq.q5: Where should I book my hotel room? How much does it cost?
faq.a5:
We recommend booking your stay at Hotel Omni Mont-Royal, our official partner and the preferred accommodation for all attendees. We negotiate a discounted room rate with the hotel — the rate and room-block details go out closer to the event.

Hotel Omni Mont-Royal: Booking Link
faq.q6: Do I have to book a hotel room?
faq.a6:
If you are attending CUSEC as part of a student delegation, yes — you are required to stay at the official CUSEC hotel. Over the years we have run into a number of issues when attendees are not staying at the designated conference hotel.

Ask your Head Delegate any questions you may have about accommodation. For any exceptional circumstances, ask your Head Delegate to discuss your situation with the rest of the organizing team.
faq.q7: Can I get a refund or resell my ticket?
faq.a7:
It is strictly forbidden to re-sell a CUSEC ticket above the purchased price.

Refunds are available 30 days after purchase, or until December 27, 2026 at 11:59 PM (EST), whichever comes first.

If you cannot attend, please email info@cusec.net and CC your Head Delegate if applicable. We will do our best to assist you.
faq.q8: Will meals be provided during our stay?
faq.a8: Coffee and tea will be available for delegates. While meals are not provided, there are numerous nearby dining options to explore Montréal’s culinary scene!
